architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: The client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Server
architectural_units.description: The server is the software that is responsible for processing user requests.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway Service
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for the management, authentication and authorization of platform users.

architectural_units.name: Core Service
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform, it would be the main core of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Analytical Module Service
architectural_units.description: This service has as its main function to obtain and process the data of the playlogs, the connections and the actions in platform.

architectural_units.name: Player API Service
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players receiving all the information corresponding to this.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket Service
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players, and in this way allows the exchange of information between them.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Framework used to develop the different services that interact with each other.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Programming language used for the development of the backend.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Database used to store all the data necessary for the operation of the system.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Object storage service used to store JSON documents containing playlogs, connections and audit trail.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: NoSQL database service used to store playlogs in real time.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: Service that allows performing SQL queries on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: Data integration service used for metadata storage and table definitions.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Service for data processing and ingestion specifically aimed at data streaming.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: Service whose main function is the loading of large amounts of data into data warehouses.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: A device that can be internal or external, which allows screens to play content.
The presentation layer communicates with the business layer, more specifically with the Api Gateway, using the HTTP protocol.
The Api Gateway service communicates with the Core service and the Analytical Module service using the TCP protocol.
The Web Socket service carries out the communication between the platform and the players, allowing the exchange of information between them.
The Web Socket service processes data from players and stores it in the database and cloud services.
The Core service interacts with the database and cloud services.
The Analytical Module service interacts with cloud services and the database.
Amazon Athena performs SQL queries on data stored in Amazon S3.
Kinesis Data Streams reads data from different producers (NestJS microservices) and sends it to consumers (Kinesis Data Firehose).
Kinesis Data Firehose loads data into data warehouses (Amazon S3).

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: The presentation layer communicates with the business layer, more specifically with the Api Gateway, using the HTTP protocol.

architectural_units.name: TCP
architectural_units.description: The communication between the Api Gateway service is using the TCP communication protocol.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture.

patterns.name: Layered Architecture
patterns.description: The client-server model uses a 3-layer architecture, where the system is divided into 3 layers.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform.
